item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00180","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C05","C10","C03"],"selected_candidate_label":"C05","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C05 plausibly supplied a concrete and material template. Both texts present Columbus as an enduring inspiration whose courage and exploration of the unknown linked the Old and New Worlds, then adapt that example to the contemporary efforts of free peoples. The child compresses and modernizes C05's sequence: Columbus's courageous exploration, its inspirational legacy, the connection between the two worlds, and an appeal to apply his qualities to present efforts toward unity and a better future. C10 and C03 share some of the child's Cold War-era vocabulary and inspirational rhetoric, but neither matches its Columbus-specific structure and imagery nearly as closely.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"The memory of Christopher Columbus--a common heritage of the Old and New World--is even in the Atomic Age a source of inspiration","parent_excerpt":"Christopher Columbus, with undaunted courage, traversed the uncharged Atlantic and discovered a new world; ... the saga of his exploits has stirred the imagination of men throughout the centuries and has inspired many other quests for larger horizons","explanation":"Both frame Columbus's discovery as a continuing source of inspiration for later efforts to cross new frontiers."},{"child_excerpt":"Out of courage, perseverance in purpose and unshakable confidence in his principles, he fashioned a new age in human history.","parent_excerpt":"in the exploration of uncharted ways toward such unity we may take guidance from the life and deeds of Christopher Columbus","explanation":"The child elaborates the same exemplary function: Columbus's qualities and deeds provide guidance for present action."},{"child_excerpt":"Those same qualities today can strengthen the men and women of the United States and of all freedom--loving countries ... we too shall build a new and better world","parent_excerpt":"the new and old worlds, to whose unity Christopher Columbus contributed so much, are striving toward further unity through the closer association of free peoples","explanation":"Both pivot from Columbus and the Old/New World connection to a contemporary project undertaken by free peoples."}]}
